verdict.rationale: EmailOctopus's own marketing copy says subscriber-provided data can be used to segment emails, so it has a first-party segmentation capability based on profile attributes. Nothing beyond that one marketing line documents how segments work. missing for 10: tag-based segment conditions, segments built from behavioral events (opens/clicks), evidence that segments update live as data changes, in-depth segmentation docs, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a marketer, I can build audience segments from profile attributes, tags, and behavioral events, and they stay live as data changes

citations.quote: Ask your subscribers anything, and use that data to segment and personalise your emails
Keep your subscribers organised so that you can target them with the emails they want to receive
